items.title: Trump administration moves ahead with new crypto rules, with key bill stalled in Congress
items.summary: The Trump administration is aggressively pushing forward with executive actions to bolster the cryptocurrency industry as comprehensive regulatory legislation stalls in the Senate.

items.title: Bitcoin price spikes after Trump meets with crypto leaders and pushes CLARITY Act
items.summary: Bitcoin (BTC-USD) surged past $70,000 after Trump met with cryptocurrency leaders at the White House and called on Congress to pass the CLARITY Act. Yahoo Finance Fed Correspondent Jennifer Schonberger reports on who was among the two dozen attendees at the meeting and whether there is real progress on the stalled digital asset legislation.

items.title: Bitcoin Heads for Best Week Since 2024 as Trump-Fueled Crypto Rally Rages On
items.summary: It’s been a stellar week for cryptos—and it’s about more than just President Donald Trump calling for Congress to pass the Clarity Act.

items.title: Robinhood shares climb as crypto regulation hopes boost investor sentiment
items.summary: Robinhood (NASDAQ:HOOD) shares rose nearly 4. 9% in pre-market trading on Friday as renewed optimism over US cryptocurrency regulation fuelled buying across digital asset-related stocks.

items.title: Crypto stocks extend rally as Bitcoin jumps on US regulatory momentum
items.summary: Cryptocurrency-linked shares continued their advance on Friday as Bitcoin (COIN:BTCUSD) climbed to its highest levels since late May, supported by renewed optimism over US digital asset regulation and improving appetite for risk. The latest gains followed President Donald Trump’s call for lawmakers to establish clearer rules for the cryptocurrency industry, adding regulatory momentum to a market already benefiting from Bitcoin’s sharp recovery.

items.title: Crypto stocks continue rallying as Bitcoin extends gains on regulation push
items.summary: Investing.com -- Crypto-linked stocks rallied Friday as Bitcoin extended its climb to levels not seen since late May, after President Trump called on lawmakers to pass clear regulatory rules for digital assets.
